en.hubeali:
From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Muyassar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
en.sarwar: 15. It is narrated from the narrator of previous Hadith from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Muyassir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Selling above fair piece to a believing person is unlawful.’”
